locations.name: Khazad-Throm
locations.description: Ancient dwarven realm beneath a mountain, built around mines, forges, vast halls, magma channels, and deep tunnel systems.

locations.name: Durin's Chasm
locations.description: Major defensive chokepoint spanned by two narrow stone bridges.

locations.name: Iron Footing
locations.description: Dwarven defensive encampment established opposite the enemy line near the Broken Shard theater.

locations.name: Broken Shard Passage
locations.description: Unstable, narrow route through fractured stone and crystal near magma flows, used for the decisive flanking maneuver.

locations.name: Goblin Burrow
locations.description: Labyrinthine goblin stronghold and site of the campaign's final battle.

locations.name: Western dwarven mine
locations.description: Moderate mine established after the war in the Valley's western mountains to extract iron ore, silver, granite, and gems.

locations.name: Dwarven settlement in the Valley
locations.description: Permanent dwarven community of granite houses and iron forges near the spring of the Silver River.

locations.name: Khazad-Throm embassy in River City
locations.description: Permanent dwarven diplomatic office near the docks of River City.
